- Who built the Aistad platform? Vaibhav Kothari built and shipped the Aistad B2B SaaS platform as a Founding Engineer, working on fee management, payment collection, platform maintenance, UI improvements, GDPR compliance, and production reliability. Aistad: https://aistad.com
